Original reasoning and exact quotes preserved.

Sixty-four reader disagreements remain explicitly dispositioned, not consensus.016 medial meniscal reduced body mass accepted as abnormal morphology positive versus reader degeneration-negative; global morphology adjudication required. Qualified ligament/meniscus/cartilage/fluid/Baker absence remains uncertain.023 local no subchondral edema in all compartments does not independently exclude global bonebruise.025 intact other articular surfaces refers to osseous contour, not lateral cartilage.026 no definite OC lesion now informative but qualified.047 lateral differential mucoid wording is not the separate medial no-tear assertion.043 bilateral pain indication with single unsided findings block retained as correspondence flag, no assumed two-knee examination.

All reader notes and flags considered. Numeric-only Baker quantities remain uncertain; named ICRS/Outerbridge depth does not provide missing extent; bare cartilage grades remain uncalibrated.023 intact versus displaced medial meniscal fragment, malformed lateral dimensions and PF low/high parenthetical contradiction preserved.030 compartment-heading/meniscus-name conflict masks both menisci; broad high/full lateral loss and throughout-trochlea PF loss remain qualitative extent positives flagged for global QA.041 second medial/lateral grade2 localization contradiction leaves lateral uncertain while independent medial surface tear positive.044 explicit all-cartilage <=50% negative and question-mark contusion uncertain.027 complete MCL with extensive edema interpreted acute-context positive; fracture acuity remains separately unknown.038 tumor dimensions not cartilage measurements.049 lipoma arborescens not explicit synovitis, quadriceps tendon ossification not acute bone fracture.
